findings.claim: A recorded page click with no extractable interpretation is emitted as authored with a null interpretation, causing contract validation to throw instead of returning a truthful unresolved observation.
evidence: The pre-review normalizer derives authored status from the selected target and constructs an action whenever that status is authored and a click was recorded, without requiring a selected interpretation.

The resulting null interpretation reaches the contract validator, whose authored-observation invariant rejects it; an isolated executable probe against the sealed pre-review tree reports null_interpretation_throws=true.
The post-review repair derives an effective unresolved status when interpretation is absent, and the named regression test passes in the isolated post-review checkpoint.
findings.adjudication: This is high severity and blocking because a supported rendered-click path can abort Visual Evidence authoring rather than produce the contract-required explicit unresolved result.

findings.claim: An ambiguous Graph selection discards its recorded click action because action preservation is incorrectly conditioned on authored status, even when a valid selected interpretation exists.
evidence: The pre-review normalizer emits an action only when status is authored and clickRecorded is true; ambiguous Graph routes are unresolved by design, so their click action is omitted.
An isolated executable probe against the sealed pre-review tree reports ambiguous_click_action_preserved=false.
The post-review repair conditions action creation on recorded click plus selected interpretation, and the named ambiguous-Graph regression test passes in the isolated post-review checkpoint.
findings.adjudication: This is high severity and blocking because it silently loses explicit user evidence and provenance on a supported ambiguous route, violating the contract's unresolved-path preservation requirement.

adjudication_notes: The historical consolidated review identifies both findings as blocking high-severity defects and records two repair iterations.
The reconstructed pre-review tree still passes its original 10 focused tests, while the post-review tree passes 12 tests including the two named regressions.
Executable pre/post probes establish the behavior independently of the historical review prose.

limitations: Truth is bounded to this case contract and artifact manifest.
The pre-review tree has medium reconstruction confidence because exact transient worktree bytes were not retained.
Future evidence can correct sealed truth only through a provenance-bearing superseding artifact.
